title: RAW UNREVIEWED: wine preserves collected juice in one event and carries a dose in another
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. In the complete Pliny Natural History XXII.29 chapter as held in the 1856 Bostock/Riley English translation layer, wine is first added to collected helioscopium juice because this makes it keep better; later, plant material is taken in wine or hydromel as an antidote to venom. The source also keeps rose-oil/headache, leaf-juice/salt/warts, topical leaves/infants, and root-leaf-suet/topical gout as distinct branches. Propose a construction that assigns one liquid adjunct a preservative relation in the preparation phase and another carrier role in a recipient-directed administration phase; the mere shared liquid name would not make the events or participants identical. Rival: flat remedy-list coordination or one undifferentiated “with wine” adjunct. Whole unit is all three chapter paragraphs and all edition notes 2596–2612; the 1856 translation is not presented as a medieval or freshly collated Latin witness. No Voynich target or word is selected. This substantially overlaps IDEA712's broader liquid-role question; retain the narrower distinction explicitly: preservation relation versus an oral dose-carrier relation, not extraction solvent versus administration vehicle. It is not an independent second confirmation.

design.mechanism: An ingredient-preservation relation increases keeping time after collection; a distinct administration relation takes a plant preparation in an oral vehicle to a named antidote use. The roles require distinct events and need not share a material token or recipient.
design.unit: The entire AF_COMPLETE_PASSAGE.md / AF_COMPLETE_SOURCE.json chapter XXII.29: all three source paragraphs plus edition notes 2596–2612. Source layer: Bostock/Riley, Natural History volume IV, London 1856, English translation; not a new Latin/medieval collation.
design.contrast: Preservative adjunct versus dose carrier with separately bound operation/recipient roles versus a flat list, one generic adjunct role, or a single shared wine event.
design.prediction: A complete future target account would need distinct predicate/participant bindings for collected juice kept with wine and plant material taken in wine or hydromel for the venom use; it must preserve other explicit branches (oil/headache, salt/warts, topical leaves, root-and-fat gout) rather than assigning them the same route. If all adjuncts collapse to one generic function, this model fails.
design.scope: Raw source model only. No target access or lexical mapping. Related dependency: IDEA712 asks whether a liquid is extraction solvent or administration vehicle; this proposal is narrower and potentially overlapping, not a claimed new confirmed mechanism.
